what.text: This page follows refugees from Mali living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 10392 Malian refugees in France, 2.0% of all refugees from Mali.
Mauritania hosts the most Malian refugees, followed by the Niger, Burkina Faso and Spain.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Mali in 2009 and from 2012 to 2025, with Ansar Dine, AQIM and MUJAO among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025, and over the government and Azawad territory with the FLA from 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 156 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
